strategy: Count square units in one row, then multiply by the number of rows.

questions.question: A square pink tabletop has a side length of 6 centimeters. What is its area, in square centimeters?

portableQuestion.question: A square pink tabletop has a side length of 6 centimeters. What is its area, in square centimeters?

steps.intent: \text{First, let us find the area of one row}
steps.hint: \text{Count one square centimeter for each centimeter along the row}
\text{Multiply the area of one row by the number of rows}
\text{Give the total number of square centimeters}

language.unitIntro: A 1 cm × 1 cm tile covers one square centimetre. Area measures how many square units cover a flat shape, with no gaps or overlap.
language.rowPrompt: How many square centimetres does one row cover?
language.squarePrompt: What side length makes a square with this area?
language.totalPrompt: What is the total area, in square centimetres?
